name: Inter-American Institute for Global Change Research (IAI)
program: Research projects and seed grants (calls for applicants, STeP fellowships, training scholarships, co-funded calls)
collect_note: The IAI home page 'Recently Published' cards are read twice a day; a card whose text names a call, applicants, applications, fellows, scholarships or a request for expressions of interest becomes a row, and its own page is read for the 'Application deadline' date (up to five pages per run). Chosen because the IAI calls hub (post/detail/Call-for-applicants) has no list of current calls (it shows only a 'Past calls' link), and the news archive (/en/news) lags behind: its newest call (HARMONIZE, deadline 23 Nov 2026) is absent there but present on the home page. Only the home page cards are read, so a call that is posted and leaves the three-card window between runs is missed; the funder-owned pages past-calls and news are not read by this config because one config has one listing.
